conclusion: The cited unfolded FP16 checkpoint is plausibly a storage expansion of the published packed ternary values, rather than an unavailable pre-quantization training checkpoint. Public code and immutable metadata provide a concrete independent reconstruction candidate. They do not authenticate the exact original authoring checkpoint, conversion invocation or all-48 result.

primaryPointers.observation: Evaluation is described as using an unfolded FP16 expansion of the pack, preserving its ternary representation; this is stronger than merely stating that the checkpoint is not shipped.
Reproduction requires an unfolded FP16 checkpoint that this repository does not ship. This does not by itself establish that its values cannot be reconstructed from public packed inputs.
The exporter loads and F32-normalizes the selected direction; named checkpoint tensors are individually read from a safetensors index and cast to F32.

Optional block-zero checking reconstructs weights by codec transcode, affine dequantization, explicit F32 cast and inverse FWHT, then compares checkpoint identity and two candidate V-head permutations. It does not independently verify all48.
Each nonembedding A factor is the F32 normalized direction left-multiplied by the supplied output-by-input matrix; B is the negated direction.
The public transform casts to F32, applies normalized blockwise Hadamard, applies signs after the transform for inverse mode, then casts back to the incoming dtype.
Packed modules are tied to their language_model-prefixed weight/scales/biases/signs arrays and declared block size; signs must be present and binary signs for transformed modules.
Immutable metadata names all48 canonical SSM out_proj modules, block1024/F16 and grouped GDN activation layout.
The immutable file manifest and repository LFS metadata agree on the model.safetensors raw identity; downloaded small source files independently match this manifest.

candidateIndependentConstruction: Bind the full immutable public packed input and its actual tensor-header/transform identities on hosted infrastructure before claiming payload verification.
For each declared SSM matrix, independently decode affine 2-bit values and preserve its explicit grouped channel layout.
Apply the published F32 inverse normalized block1024 Hadamard and corresponding sign vector; explicitly declare and retain the candidate final F16 storage rounding.
Convert the reconstructed F16 matrix back to F32 as the exporter does, normalize the actual selected direction with the declared F32 algorithm, and independently reproduce r @ W.
Compare every candidate A channel at all48 sites against the exact approved adapter under the existing declared tight bounds, retaining all failures and arithmetic/toolchain identities.
Describe results as independently reconstructed public-input references; do not label them the authenticated author-original checkpoint unless separate evidence establishes that identity.
missingFacts: No immutable record binds the approved adapter to an exact author-original checkpoint index/shard/tensor identity or original expansion invocation.

The inspected public source does not retain the exact full FP16 expansion/serialization implementation and rounding record used for the adapter authoring run; the proposed final-F16 pipeline is an inference to test.
The published requirements pin MLX0.32.0/MLX-LM0.31.3/MLX-VLM0.6.3, but NumPy is only >=2.0 and the author-specific Python, safetensors, GGUF writer and BLAS builds/invocation are not authenticated.
No tensor, sign-vector or direction payload was downloaded in this reassessment; there are no actual all48 A comparisons.
A successful public reconstruction would not alone prove native writer-input mapping, loaded-zero/no-adapter identity, nonzero logits/live-state effect or human quality/performance acceptance.
priorInterpretationCorrection: Retain older audits as historical observations, but narrow any claim that a private pre-quantization FP16 source is necessarily required. The external original-run authenticity question and independently testable public reconstruction route are different facts.
